title: Square Crop Keeps Whole Sneaker
tests: Tests converting a 16:9 photo to square while preserving the complete subject and its proportions.

faults.what: The square crop cuts off both the heel and toe, including the ends of the sole, instead of keeping the entire sneaker visible.

judge.summary: The image is square and preserves the original photo's appearance, but crops off both ends of the sneaker.

must_haves.why: The output has equal width and height.

must_haves.item: The sneaker is the same white leather sneaker as in the attachment.
must_haves.why: The visible leather panels, stitching, laces, and sole match the source sneaker.

must_haves.item: The entire sneaker, including toe, heel and sole, remains visible.
must_haves.why: The heel is cut off at the left edge and the toe at the right edge, along with portions of the sole.

must_haves.item: The sneaker has natural proportions, without stretching or squeezing.
must_haves.why: The retained portion appears uniformly enlarged by cropping, without visible stretching or squeezing.

must_haves.item: The retained floor and background match the source photo, with no added text or decorative elements.
must_haves.why: The visible floor and background objects match the source, and no text or decoration has been added.
